items.html:
An allrounder capable of batting in the top six and bowling first or second change, Jack Wildermuth enjoyed a breakthrough season for Queensland in 2015-16. He played eight Sheffield Shield matches and scored his maiden first-class century, while also earning Man of the Match honours in another game for his seven wickets against Victoria. The retirement of James Hopes should ensure plenty more opportunities for Wildermuth, who previously worked as a barista at a cafe at Allan Border Field, and was often to be found making coffees for his future Queensland team-mates.
Brydon Coverdale
